summary: Feature 26 Job Search PDF export (Document Output option 3.b) — independent backend + frontend re-verification. Backend pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_job_search_documents_pdf.py) 8/8 PASSED in 1.11s: (1) GET /api/job-search/documents/job_principal-fullstack-engineer/pdf?view=cv as admin returns 200, content-type=application/pdf, body starts with %PDF, Content-Disposition=attachment filename=cv-job_principal-fullstack-engineer.pdf; (2) v15 theme BYPASS working — response headers x-pdf-theme-policy='exempt-job-search-document' and x-pdf-theme-policy-mode='job_search_document_exempt' (NOT enforced-v15) — PDF is clean, no platform chrome stamp; (3) view=cover returns 200 valid PDF with cover-letter-* filename and same exempt headers; (4) unauthenticated request => 401 (auth guard applied before middleware exemption); (5) nonexistent job_id => 404; (6) view=bogus => 400; (7) pypdf text extraction succeeds — no raw '**' or '# ' markdown markers appear in text layer (headings/bold correctly rendered by reportlab flowables); alpha_ratio > 0.3 confirms real CV content. (8) Scoped-exemption unit regression: _is_job_search_document_pdf_theme_exempt_path returns True only for '/api/job-search/documents/{id}/pdf' and False for '/api/admin/offers/off_abc/pdf', '/api/receipts/rct_abc/pdf', '/api/job-search/documents' (no /pdf suffix), and learning cert path — proving the exemption is scoped ONLY to job-search doc PDFs and other platform PDFs still get v15 theme enforcement. Frontend Playwright E2E: admin cookie-login OK, navigated to /job-search, clicked 'job-search-step-documents' step, verified 'job-search-doc-download-pdf-btn' visible next to 'job-search-doc-download-btn' and 'job-search-doc-copy-btn'. Playwright expect_download captured a REAL download event with filename 'cv-job_principal-fullstack-engineer.pdf' on CV view; switched to 'job-search-doc-view-cover' and captured second download 'cover-letter-job_principal-fullstack-engineer.pdf'. Regression confirmed: Download .md button still triggers download ('cover-letter-*.md') and Copy button still shows 'job-search-doc-copied' message.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/job_search.py::_markdown_to_pdf (lines 315-386) is clean and self-contained: uses reportlab SimpleDocTemplate with ParagraphStyle for h1/h2/h3/body, converts **bold** and *italic* inline, and bullet lines via ListFlowable. Escapes text via xml.sax.saxutils.escape before inline substitution — safe against reportlab markup injection. No platform chrome, no logo, no branding — appropriate for external employer submissions.

/app/backend/routes/job_search.py::download_document_pdf (lines 389-410) properly gates with require_auth (401 for unauth), validates view∈{cv,cover} (400), returns 404 when doc missing or requested view content empty, and returns Response with attachment Content-Disposition. Minor nit: filename is placed unquoted-in-quotes; special chars in job_id could theoretically break header — mitigated because job_id is a MongoDB-stored slug (alphanumeric + hyphen). Not a blocker.

/app/backend/middleware_pdf_policy.py::_is_job_search_document_pdf_theme_exempt_path (line 116) correctly normalizes path to lowercase with leading slash and checks '/job-search/documents/' substring + endswith '/pdf' — path-based only, no route handler coupling. Exemption in send_wrapper (lines 411-416) runs early on http.response.start, stamps x-pdf-theme-policy='exempt-job-search-document' and returns immediately — theme overlay is completely skipped. Order is correct: learning-certificate exemption checked first (mutually exclusive substring), then job-search-document exemption.

/app/frontend/src/components/jobSearch/DocumentsTab.tsx::downloadPdf handler (lines 57-76) uses api.get with responseType and triggerBlobDownload — appropriate for RN Web. Handles pdfDownloading busy state, sets status message on failure via i18n key 'jobSearch.docs.pdfFailed'. Button has both data-testid and testID props for RNW/native compat. Disabled during in-flight is correct.
